'''Blaise Zirkonn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] born on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to the ancient [[House Zirkonn]], Blaise Zirkonn was educated at the best schools of her homeworld before enrolling in the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. Intending on joining the [[Imperial Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Imperial Diplomatic Corps]], she was identified by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] as a Forceful individual and directed toward the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]]. Serving for a decade as an agent within the Inquisitorius, Zirkonn was attached to the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|Emperor's Retreat]] and attended the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] court when he was present on the planet. Running the intelligence network in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] through agents like [[Zerala Dinn/Legends|Zerala Dinn]], Zirkonn was always hunting for Forcefuls to induct into the Inquisitorius.<ref name="NoP" />

==Personality and traits==
When she was a child, she was talkative, influential with charm, smile capable of disarming others and willful. As she entered adulthood her influence only refined, becoming incredibly sophisticated in getting exactly what she wanted from a couple nice words and smile. Despite Blaise Zirkonn and Zerala Dinn enjoyed hurting others, Zirkonn used violence as a last resort, preferring to talk things out and convince Force-Sensitives to join the Empire under the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] or Inquisitorius under her supervision with the possibility of promotion in time. She had only had to resort to death a handful of times. Blaise would hold respect and hatred for her targets. She preferred to escape and hunt down her targets later if their encounter went in their favor, but also preferred to keep the targets escaping to herself in fear of appearing weak among her peers. Contrary to many other of the Empire's dark side adept's, she held a personal connection with Zerala Dinn, and would opt to save him rather than let him die.<ref name="NoP" />

==Powers and abilities==
Despite not serving as an Inquisitor, Zirkonn carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of her own creation and wielded [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to influence those around her, allowing her to be more persuasive or [[Mind trick/Legends|evoke fear or hatred]] from her targets, or appear more intimidating. She also wore a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] on a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] slung over her concealed armor. In combat she preferred to focus on the greatest threat, typically [[Telekinesis/Legends|pulling]] them away from their comrades to have a personal fight between the two of them. However, if Dinn or Blaise were incapacitated then the other would cover for them while reinforcements protects the one incapacitated until they could flee.<ref name="NoP" />
